name: Ceftazidime/avibactam
route_note: IV infusion over 2 hours every 8 hours, adjusted for renal function.
targets: Class A (including KPC), class C and some class D (OXA-48) beta-lactamases (avibactam)
originator: Novexel (avibactam); developed by AstraZeneca and Forest Laboratories

discovery.by: Hoechst Marion Roussel/Aventis; developed by Novexel
discovery.note: Avibactam, a non-beta-lactam diazabicyclooctane inhibitor, originated in Aventis research and was developed by the spin-off Novexel, acquired by AstraZeneca in 2010.

tagline: Reserve antibiotic restoring ceftazidime against KPC and OXA-48 carbapenemase producers
summary: Ceftazidime/avibactam combines ceftazidime with avibactam, the first diazabicyclooctane beta-lactamase inhibitor. It is active against many carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales producing KPC or OXA-48 enzymes and against some multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas, but not against metallo-beta-lactamase producers.
mechanism: Ceftazidime inhibits PBP3 and blocks Gram-negative cell-wall synthesis.

Avibactam carbamylates the active-site serine of class A (ESBLs, KPC), class C (AmpC) and some class D (OXA-48) beta-lactamases. Unlike clavulanate or tazobactam, its acylation is reversible, the intact inhibitor being released to inhibit further enzymes. It does not inhibit metallo-beta-lactamases (NDM, VIM, IMP); resistance also emerges via KPC variants such as D179Y.
uses: Complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis
Infections due to aerobic Gram-negative organisms with limited treatment options (EU)

history.title: AstraZeneca acquires Novexel
history.detail: AstraZeneca buys Novexel and co-develops ceftazidime-avibactam with Forest Laboratories.

history.title: US approval
history.detail: The FDA approves Avycaz under the GAIN Act's qualified infectious disease product programme.

history.title: Pfizer acquires rights
history.detail: Pfizer acquires AstraZeneca's late-stage small-molecule antibiotics business, including ex-US rights.

history.title: WHO Reserve list
history.detail: Ceftazidime-avibactam is added to the WHO Essential Medicines List as a Reserve antibiotic.

history.title: AbbVie
history.detail: AbbVie acquires Allergan, which held US rights to Avycaz.

serious: Reduced efficacy in moderate renal impairment (observed in trials)

facts: Ceftazidime-avibactam is often combined with aztreonam to treat metallo-beta-lactamase producers when aztreonam-avibactam is unavailable.
